rabbi-acha-bar-yaakov.name: Rabbi Aḥa bar Ya’akov
rabbi-acha-bar-yaakov.bio: Amora named here as Rabbi Aḥa bar Ya’akov; probably the Babylonian Amora elsewhere called Rav Aḥa bar Ya’akov.
rabbi-acha-bar-yaakov.prompt: A thoughtful scholar in his 60s with a long greying beard and a steady, attentive gaze, wrapped in a plain wool mantle; background of a dim study house with mud-brick walls and oil lamps.
